The '''Sespe system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], on the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Topa]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Torega]].
